title: Personal Checking: overdraft protection transfer fee by tier
content:
## Scope

An overdraft protection transfer moves funds from a linked savings account into a Personal Checking account. This card lists, per checking tier, the fee for each such transfer and the most transfer fees charged to one account on one business day.

## Transfer fee by tier

| Tier | Fee per overdraft protection transfer from a linked savings account (USD) | Most transfer fees charged per account per business day |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 | 0 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 0 |
| Everyday Checking | 10.00 | 1 |
| Interest Checking | 10.00 | 1 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 0 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 0 |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Which checking tiers charge for an overdraft protection transfer?**
A: Everyday Checking and Interest Checking, at 10.00 USD per transfer, with at most one transfer fee per account per business day.

**Q: Where does a correctly charged transfer fee amount come from?**
A: From the checking tier of the account the transfer went into, as shown above; the fee belongs to the checking account, not to the savings account the funds came from.

**Hypothetical day**: on an Interest Checking account, three transfers are made on the same business day. The daily maximum of 1 means one transfer fee of 10.00 USD is the most that can be charged to the account for that day.
